name: campussport
description: CampusSport monorepo: NestJS API (backend/) and React PWA (frontend/).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm --prefix backend run db:setup
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,yellow,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix backend run start:worker:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
